changeSet.createView: SELECT empl.id AS employee_id, empl.first_name, empl.last_name, empl.phone_number, empl.email, empl.image_path, empl.status AS employee_status, pos.id AS position_id, pos.name_en AS position_name_en, pos.name_uk AS position_name_uk, ti.id AS tariffs_info_id, reg.id AS region_id, reg.name_en AS region_name_en, reg.name_uk AS region_name_uk, loc.id AS location_id, loc.name_en AS location_name_en, loc.name_uk AS location_name_uk, recev_stat.id AS receiving_station_id, recev_stat.name AS receiving_station_name, cour.id AS courier_id, cour.name_en AS courier_name_en, cour.name_uk AS courier_name_uk FROM employees empl LEFT JOIN employee_position ep ON empl.id = ep.employee_id LEFT JOIN positions pos ON ep.position_id = pos.id LEFT JOIN tariff_infos_receiving_employee_mapping tirem ON empl.id = tirem.employee_id LEFT JOIN tariffs_info ti ON tirem.tariffs_info_id = ti.id LEFT JOIN tariffs_locations tl ON ti.id = tl.tariffs_info_id LEFT JOIN locations loc ON loc.id = tl.location_id LEFT JOIN tariffs_info_receiving_stations_mapping tirsm ON ti.id = tirsm.tariffs_info_id LEFT JOIN receiving_stations recev_stat ON tirsm.receiving_station_id = recev_stat.id LEFT JOIN regions reg ON loc.region_id = reg.id LEFT JOIN courier cour ON cour.id = ti.courier_id;

changeSet.author: Oleh Popovych
changeSet.createView: WITH order_sums AS (SELECT obm.order_id, sum(obm.confirmed_quantity) AS total_confirmed_quantity, sum(obm.exported_quantity) AS total_exported_quantity, sum(obm.amount) AS total_amount FROM order_bag_mapping obm GROUP BY obm.order_id), group_capacity AS (SELECT obm.order_id, sum( CASE WHEN bag.capacity = 120 AND bag.name_en::text = 'Mix waste'::text THEN CASE WHEN os.total_confirmed_quantity IS NULL AND os.total_exported_quantity IS NULL THEN obm.amount WHEN os.total_exported_quantity IS NULL THEN obm.confirmed_quantity ELSE obm.exported_quantity END ELSE 0 END) AS mixed_waste_120, sum( CASE WHEN bag.capacity = 60 AND bag.name_en::text = 'Textile waste'::text THEN CASE WHEN os.total_confirmed_quantity IS NULL AND os.total_exported_quantity IS NULL THEN obm.amount WHEN os.total_exported_quantity IS NULL THEN obm.confirmed_quantity ELSE obm.exported_quantity END ELSE 0 END) AS textile_waste_60, sum( CASE WHEN bag.capacity = 20 AND bag.name_en::text = 'Textile waste'::text THEN CASE WHEN os.total_confirmed_quantity IS NULL AND os.total_exported_quantity IS NULL THEN obm.amount WHEN os.total_exported_quantity IS NULL THEN obm.confirmed_quantity ELSE obm.exported_quantity END ELSE 0 END) AS textile_waste_20, string_agg( CASE WHEN bag.name_en::text != ALL (ARRAY ['Mix waste'::character varying, 'Textile waste'::character varying]::text[]) THEN CASE WHEN os.total_confirmed_quantity IS NULL AND os.total_exported_quantity IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN obm.amount = 0 THEN NULL::text ELSE concat(bag.name_uk, ' ', bag.capacity, 'л - ', obm.amount, 'шт') END WHEN os.total_exported_quantity IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN obm.confirmed_quantity = 0 THEN NULL::text ELSE concat(bag.name_uk, ' ', bag.capacity, 'л - ', obm.confirmed_quantity, 'шт') END ELSE CASE WHEN obm.exported_quantity = 0 THEN NULL::text ELSE concat(bag.name_uk, ' ', bag.capacity, 'л - ', obm.exported_quantity, 'шт') END END ELSE NULL::text END, ', '::text) AS other_packages, string_agg( CASE WHEN bag.name_en::text != ALL (ARRAY ['Mix waste'::character varying, 'Textile waste'::character varying]::text[]) THEN CASE WHEN os.total_confirmed_quantity IS NULL AND os.total_exported_quantity IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN obm.amount = 0 THEN NULL::text ELSE concat(bag.name_en, ' ', bag.capacity, 'l - ', obm.amount, 'pcs') END WHEN os.total_exported_quantity IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN obm.confirmed_quantity = 0 THEN NULL::text ELSE concat(bag.name_en, ' ', bag.capacity, 'l - ', obm.confirmed_quantity, 'pcs') END ELSE CASE WHEN obm.exported_quantity = 0 THEN NULL::text ELSE concat(bag.name_en, ' ', bag.capacity, 'l - ', obm.exported_quantity, 'pcs') END END ELSE NULL::text END, ', '::text) AS other_packages_eng FROM order_bag_mapping obm LEFT JOIN bag ON obm.bag_id = bag.id LEFT JOIN order_sums os ON obm.order_id = os.order_id GROUP BY obm.order_id ORDER BY obm.order_id) SELECT o.id, o.order_status, o.order_payment_status, o.order_date::date AS order_date, (SELECT max(p.settlement_date::date) AS max FROM payment p WHERE p.order_id = o.id AND o.order_payment_status::text = 'PAID'::text) AS payment_date, concat_ws(' '::text, uu.first_name, uu.last_name) AS client_name, uu.phone_number AS client_phone_number, uu.email AS client_email, concat_ws(' '::text, uu.sender_first_name, uu.sender_last_name) AS sender_name, uu.sender_phone_number AS sender_phone, uu.sender_email, u.violations AS violations_amount, a.region_uk, a.city_uk, a.district_uk, concat_ws(', '::text, concat(a.street_uk, ' ', a.house_number), CASE WHEN a.house_corpus IS NOT NULL AND a.house_corpus::text != ''::text THEN concat('корп.', a.house_corpus) ELSE 'корп.- '::text END, CASE WHEN a.entrance_number IS NOT NULL AND a.entrance_number::text != ''::text THEN concat('п.', a.entrance_number) ELSE 'п.- '::text END) AS address_uk, a.address_comment AS comment_to_address_for_client, gc.mixed_waste_120, gc.textile_waste_60, gc.textile_waste_20, gc.other_packages AS other_packages_uk, gc.other_packages_eng AS other_packages_en, o.sum_total_amount_without_discounts AS total_order_sum, (SELECT string_agg(c.code::text, ', '::text) AS string_agg FROM certificate c WHERE c.order_id = o.id) AS order_certificate_code, COALESCE((SELECT sum(c.points) AS sum FROM certificate c WHERE c.order_id = o.id), 0::bigint) + COALESCE(o.points_to_use, 0) AS general_discount, (COALESCE(o.sum_total_amount_without_discounts, 0::bigint)::numeric - (COALESCE((SELECT sum(p.amount) AS sum FROM payment p WHERE p.order_id = o.id AND p.payment_status::text = 'PAID'::text), 0::numeric) + (COALESCE((SELECT sum(c.points) AS sum FROM certificate c WHERE c.order_id = o.id), 0::bigint) * 100 + COALESCE(o.points_to_use, 0) * 100)::numeric))::bigint AS amount_due, o.comment AS comment_for_order_by_client, (COALESCE((SELECT sum(p.amount) AS sum FROM payment p WHERE p.order_id = o.id AND p.payment_status::text = 'PAID'::text), 0::numeric) + (COALESCE((SELECT sum(c.points) AS sum FROM certificate c WHERE c.order_id = o.id), 0::bigint) * 100 + COALESCE(o.points_to_use, 0) * 100)::numeric)::bigint AS total_payment, o.date_of_export, concat_ws('-'::text, o.deliver_from::time without time zone, o.deliver_to::time without time zone) AS time_of_export, (SELECT string_agg(oe.additional_order::text, '; '::text) AS string_agg FROM order_additional oe WHERE oe.orders_id = o.id) AS id_order_from_shop, r.name AS receiving_station, r.id AS receiving_station_id, (SELECT concat_ws(', '::text, e_1.first_name, e_1.last_name) AS concat_ws FROM employee_order_position eop LEFT JOIN employees e_1 ON eop.employee_id = e_1.id WHERE eop.order_id = o.id AND eop.position_id = 3) AS responsible_logic_man, (SELECT e_1.id FROM employee_order_position eop LEFT JOIN employees e_1 ON eop.employee_id = e_1.id WHERE eop.order_id = o.id AND eop.position_id = 3) AS responsible_logic_man_id, (SELECT concat_ws(', '::text, e_1.first_name, e_1.last_name) AS concat_ws FROM employee_order_position eop LEFT JOIN employees e_1 ON eop.employee_id = e_1.id WHERE eop.order_id = o.id AND eop.position_id = 5) AS responsible_driver, (SELECT e_1.id FROM employee_order_position eop LEFT JOIN employees e_1 ON eop.employee_id = e_1.id WHERE eop.order_id = o.id AND eop.position_id = 5) AS responsible_driver_id, (SELECT concat_ws(', '::text, e_1.first_name, e_1.last_name) AS concat_ws FROM employee_order_position eop LEFT JOIN employees e_1 ON eop.employee_id = e_1.id WHERE eop.order_id = o.id AND eop.position_id = 2) AS responsible_caller, (SELECT e_1.id FROM employee_order_position eop LEFT JOIN employees e_1 ON eop.employee_id = e_1.id WHERE eop.order_id = o.id AND eop.position_id = 2) AS responsible_caller_id, (SELECT concat_ws(', '::text, e_1.first_name, e_1.last_name) AS concat_ws FROM employee_order_position eop LEFT JOIN employees e_1 ON eop.employee_id = e_1.id WHERE eop.order_id = o.id AND eop.position_id = 4) AS responsible_navigator, (SELECT e_1.id FROM employee_order_position eop LEFT JOIN employees e_1 ON eop.employee_id = e_1.id WHERE eop.order_id = o.id AND eop.position_id = 4) AS responsible_navigator_id, o.blocked AS is_blocked, concat_ws(', '::text, e.first_name, e.last_name) AS blocked_by, a.region_en, a.city_en, a.district_en, a.region_id, a.city_id, a.district_id, concat_ws(', '::text, concat(a.street_en, ' ', a.house_number), CASE WHEN a.house_corpus IS NOT NULL AND a.house_corpus::text != ''::text THEN concat('b.', a.house_corpus) ELSE 'b.- '::text END, CASE WHEN a.entrance_number IS NOT NULL AND a.entrance_number::text != ''::text THEN concat('e.', a.entrance_number) ELSE 'e.- '::text END) AS address_en, o.tariffs_info_id, o.admin_comment AS comment_for_order_by_admin FROM orders o LEFT JOIN group_capacity gc ON o.id = gc.order_id LEFT JOIN employees e ON o.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN receiving_stations r ON o.receiving_station_id = r.id LEFT JOIN ubs_user uu ON o.ubs_user_id = uu.id LEFT JOIN order_address a ON uu.id = a.id LEFT JOIN users u ON o.users_id = u.id;
